title: Bulk order upload for trade customers
problemStatement: Trade customers place 40-line orders by emailing a spreadsheet to the support desk. Support re-keys them, taking around 6 hours a week and introducing errors.
successMeasure: 80% of trade orders self-served within two months; re-keying time under one hour a week.

sizing.basis: Team broke it into stories at refinement on 2026-08-07; range covers whether validation is server-side only or both.

valueEstimate.basis: 5.5 support hours/wk x $58 fully-loaded, annualised, plus 1.2% error-driven credit notes avoided

assumptions: Existing CSV import limits are raised rather than rewritten
